name: date-input
title: Date Input
description: UI SDK DateInput styled as a field: a date typed segment by segment in the locale's order, ISO values, min, max and unavailable dates marked invalid, floating labels and FormField binding.
docs: `<DateInput defaultValue min max unavailable locale granularity>` in a `Field`: the label names the group, each segment is a small input in the locale's order (`locale`, or the page's), and the value is an ISO date (`"2026-11-02"`, or `"2026-11-02T14:30"` with `granularity="minute"`), `null` until every segment is filled. A date outside `min`/`max` or on an `unavailable` date sets `data-invalid` and the destructive edge. Paste a whole date into any segment. `labelPlacement="in"`/`"on"` float the Field's label (the empty segments' placeholders show only while one is focused) and `FormField` binds the value. Use `DatePicker` when people should also pick from a calendar.
